name: jmk-global-holdings
description: Corporate website for JMK Global Holdings — Next.js static frontend + Express/MySQL API

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix frontend run start" "npm --prefix backend run start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
